audit_items.proof_trace: Every /api/* route in index.ts (L68-77) explicitly registers authMiddleware, which validates a Bearer token against API_AUTH_TOKEN before the handler executes. The getAllMembers query uses an explicit field projection that excludes is_admin, and team_leaders is only queried in auth-gated rolesSync/rolesSyncAll endpoints whose responses emit sync statistics rather than raw member rows. No unauthenticated endpoint can return is_admin or leader status.
